scientific_question: Can a supervised model identify four social behaviors at frame resolution from re-estimated mouse pose?
task_type: Supervised multilabel frame segmentation. ResiFuse is a source reference, not an architecture requirement. Its unsupervised DEC task is excluded.

pose.coverage: 1,810 of 1,829 official mouse submission videos is a dataset-card claim; all 108 split-matched H5 files were independently resolved, LFS-hash verified, and prepared
pose.format: One DeepLabCut H5 table per video; 1,801 rows indexed 0..1800; individuals A0/A1/A2; 12 bodyparts each; coords x/y/likelihood; undetected keypoints NaN. Numeric-only Agent NPZ contains indexed rows 0..1799; the terminal row is excluded following the pinned source preprocessor's truncation to 1,800 official label frames.
pose.resolution: Pose coordinates are in 448 x 448 pixels; the official videos are 224 x 224. Downscale coordinates by 2 for 224-pixel overlays only after confirming frame alignment.

labels.evaluation_mask: BrainPilotBench-MABe22-supervised-positive-pose-valid-v1: owner intersects any-positive grouped behavior with label-independent source-style pose validity (0.2 mean confidence, gaps bridged up to 60 frames, nonfinite keypoints excluded, union across three mice). Unlike source label-centered windows, this mask does not require a 30-frame behavior bout. An excluded all-zero frame may be an annotated negative or unannotated; source code alone cannot distinguish them. This metric does not measure false alarms on background-only frames. The owner retains the Test mask and does not use it to select Agent inputs.
labels.score: Pool TP/FP/FN across eligible unique Test frame indices per class, calculate positive F1 for each class, then mean the four F1 values. Source training code uses sigmoid(logits) >= 0.5 and deduplicates frame indices; probability threshold 0.5 follows that code. Label-independent inference windows are the benchmark adaptation.

inference_boundary: Agent development workspace receives only Train/Val pose and labels. The frozen model receives Test pose only inside isolated evaluator inference; Test labels and positive-frame eligibility remain owner-only. Complete 1,800-frame inputs are fixed from pose indices independently of behavior labels. Never transfer upstream label-centered fine-tune windows or frame_labels into model inference.
comparability: This is a BrainPilotBench adaptation. Re-estimated pose, changed frame count/resolution, four grouped labels and split prevent direct comparison with original MABe22 Appendix D. Replacing source label-selected Test windows with label-independent Agent inference changes the evaluated input, so it is not an exact ResiFuse paper reproduction either. No paper score is claimed.
engineering_acceptance: Fixed-reference public and isolated owner Test CLI checks passed; see reports/mouse-closeout-20261026/mabe22-supervised-segmentation-cli-acceptance.json. Test values remain private. No Agent benchmark run was performed.
remaining_gates: License/provenance and redistribution review for original labels and derived pose before publication
Video input is outside this pose-only task version; adding it requires a separate protocol and frame-level alignment check
